what: FYI, done by integrate-load as part of deleting load-cargo (integrate-shared.md allows the root/lock edits of the deletion): new crate crates/blaze-lower holds what load-cargo's `v2` module was (a build's units lowered into base-db's Db: lower, Lowered, Crates, Ran) plus `answer` (what a running proc macro asks of the Db), moved from load-cargo. I added `blaze-lower = { path = "crates/blaze-lower" }` to [workspace.dependencies] and its [[package]] block to Cargo.lock, and swapped load-cargo for blaze-lower in blaze-cargo, blaze-macro-eval, blaze-macro-wasm, hir-firewall. For crates.md: blaze-lower belongs to lane cargo (cargo-daemon's part, notes.md table row 'lowering units to the front end'); the `load-cargo, project-model` replaced row can name blaze-lower beside blaze-units/manifest/resolve. Tell integrate to mark it.
